interface.default: Fresh complete-state comparison of retained historical actual F03 K/Quint observations against the independent frozen oracle; no producer rerun
interface.selection: Supply all four selection options or none

exit_codes.1: first divergence or independent oracle mismatch
exit_codes.2: malformed, incomplete, unsupported or pin-mismatched input

interface.json_input_errors: status=input-error; public error responses never echo private paths/code
interface.public_diagnostics: Public first differences expose a field pointer and expected_sha256/observed_sha256; unknown pointer segments are masked. Complete raw states stay in digest-identified input artifacts. Arbitrary provenance is represented by digest only.
interface.evaluator_note: Adopted from sherlock-kc's proposal; evaluator added fieldMaps[].difference (state representation differences), numeric_bounds.UInt128_max, top-level refinement and compared_edges.
